topic: Lidar sensor offer calculation and approval
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on calculating an offer for additional Lidar sensors. Initial questions were raised regarding whether a Wi-Fi sensor was needed to complement the 2D Lidar setup, with the consensus being that a full set was required.
Later in the session, pricing concerns were briefly discussed and then resolved, leading to final approval of the quoted price.
decisions: The requirement for additional Lidar sensors (full set) was confirmed.
